description: This file is a shell script used for managing log backups and recovery operations, including creating necessary directories, copying log files, handling log rotation, and performing system-specific backup tasks.

methods.name: backupAndRecoverLogs
methods.description: Copies or moves specific log files from source to destination based on provided extensions and operation.

methods.name: backupLogsNotInList
methods.description: Backs up log files not included in the main backup list to a trash folder, preserving their content temporarily.
